title: 穷人乍富
concept: 金色旅行箱戴廉价黑墨镜
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_001, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "穷人乍富" (suddenly rich after being poor). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a simple chunky beveled gold rim and a glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, looking smug because it just became rich and is going traveling. The suitcase is closed, centered, and dominant. Add only one or two white star-shaped glints as lighting, not separate items.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: ultra-simple large readable silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, intentionally over-serious luxury applied to a dumb joke.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric turquoise enamel, small coral jewel accents on rim, black sunglasses, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
